papers.title: Neural tracking of surprisal and semantic distance in naturalistic movie viewing
papers.translated_title: 自然观影中惊奇度和语义距离的神经追踪
papers.author: O'Leary, R. M.
papers.summary: Understanding speech requires listeners to integrate incoming input with prior linguistic and thematic knowledge to access meaning, a task greatly aided by prediction. Surprisal and related phenomena (e.g., next word prediction) tend to be associated with broad activation of language regions during listening. A major challenge for interpreting the neural correlates of surprisal is that lexical expectancies are constrained both by syntactic and semantic information. In contrast, semantic distance yields more of a pure metric of relatedness between one language constituent (e.g., word, phrase, n-gram) and another within a high-dimensional semantic space. We contrasted surprisal and semantic distance in running discourse during naturalistic audiovisual language comprehension. We analyzed fMRI scans from 20 English-speaking adults who viewed the full-length film 500 Days of Summer. Our focus was on brain sensitivity to either surprisal or semantic distance as language unfolded word-by-word. To this end, we implemented a series of hierarchical voxelwise encoding models. After accounting for low-level auditory and visual features, the addition of either surprisal or semantic distance improved prediction in bilateral superior temporal gyrus (STG), left inferior frontal gyrus, and right cerebellum. Critically, both semantic distance and surprisal explained unique variation in bilateral temporal cortex after accounting for the other. These results support the notion that the brain tracks both broad probabilistic prediction as well as semantic integration. More generally, these findings extend previous work on auditory-only speech by demonstrating that surprisal and semantic distance predict meaningful neural variation even within a rich audiovisual context.
papers.translated_summary: 理解言语需要听者将输入信息与先前的语言和主题知识相结合以获取意义，而预测在很大程度上促进了这一任务。惊奇度及相关现象（例如下一个词预测）往往与听音过程中语言脑区的广泛激活有关。解释惊奇度神经相关物的一个主要挑战在于，词汇预期同时受到句法和语义信息的约束。相比之下，语义距离更能提供一种纯粹的度量，衡量一个语言成分（如词、短语、n元组）与高维语义空间中另一个成分之间的关联程度。我们在自然化的视听语言理解过程中，对连续语篇中的惊奇度和语义距离进行了对比。我们分析了20名英语母语成人在观看全长电影《和莎莫的500天》时的fMRI扫描数据。我们的关注点是大脑对惊奇度或语义距离在逐词展开的语言加工中的敏感性。为此，我们实现了一系列分层体素级编码模型。在控制了低级听觉和视觉特征之后，加入惊奇度或语义距离均改善了双侧颞上回、左侧额下回和右侧小脑的预测。关键的是，在控制另一方之后，语义距离和惊奇度均能解释双侧颞叶皮层的独特变异。这些结果支持了大脑同时追踪广泛的概率预测和语义整合这一观点。更一般地说，这些发现扩展了以往仅针对听觉言语的研究，表明即使在丰富的视听情境中，惊奇度和语义距离也能预测有意义的神经变异。

papers.title: From Geometry to Hierarchy: Charting the Dominant Modes of Human Cortical Function Through Development
papers.translated_title: 从几何到层级：通过发展描绘人类皮层功能的主导模式
papers.author: Holmes, A.
papers.summary: Cortical function in the human cortex is spatially patterned along a macroscale information processing hierarchy. This hierarchy tracks a sensory-association axis anchored at one end by unimodal sensory regions and at the other by transmodal association areas. Biophysical models of brain dynamics suggest that this axis should align with the dominant, resonant modes of cortical anatomy and geometry, but they do not. Instead, the dominant anatomical modes correspond to simple spatial gradients extending along rostro-caudal, medio-lateral, and dorso-ventral axes. How does this divergence between anatomical and functional modes of the cortex arise? Here, using four independent functional magnetic resonance imaging datasets spanning infancy to young adulthood (n=1,512, aged 0-21 years), we show that this spatial divergence is attributable to the maturation of long-range cortico-cortical inter-regional functional coupling. Specifically, we find that the dominant functional mode of the human cortex during the first 3 to 4 years of life closely resembles the rostro-caudal mode of cortical geometry, then shifts to a rudimentary sensory-association-like mode between 4 and 6 years of age and ultimately matures into a prototypical sensory-association mode by age 13. In infancy and early childhood, a linear model predicting the topography of the dominant functional mode from modes of cortical geometry substantially outperforms a model relying on the adult sensory-association mode, whereas the reverse is true in later stages of development. Furthermore, targeted removal of long-range connections causes the adult functional mode to regress from a sensory-association topography to an infant-like rostro-caudal mode. Our findings indicate that the maturation of long-range cortico-cortical coupling supports the gradual emergence of hierarchical modes of cortical function from an organization initially dominated by geometric constraints.
papers.translated_summary: 人类皮层的皮层功能沿宏观信息处理层级在空间上呈现模式化分布。该层级沿一条感觉-联合轴排列，一端以单模态感觉区为锚点，另一端以跨模态联合区为锚点。脑动力学的生物物理模型提示，该轴应与皮层解剖和几何的主导共振模式相一致，但事实并非如此。相反，主导的解剖模式对应于沿吻-尾、内-外和背-腹轴延伸的简单空间梯度。皮层解剖模式与功能模式之间的这种分歧是如何产生的？在此，我们使用四个独立的磁共振成像数据集，涵盖从婴儿期到青年期（n=1,512，年龄0-21岁），表明这种空间分歧可归因于长程皮层-皮层区域间功能耦合的成熟。具体而言，我们发现，在生命最初3至4年中，人类皮层的主导功能模式与皮层几何的吻-尾模式高度相似，随后在4至6岁之间转变为一种初步的类感觉-联合模式，并最终在13岁时成熟为一种典型的感觉-联合模式。在婴儿期和幼儿期，从皮层几何模式预测主导功能模式拓扑的线性模型显著优于依赖成人感觉-联合模式的模型，而在发育后期则相反。此外，有针对性地移除长程连接会使成人功能模式从感觉-联合拓扑退化为婴儿样的吻-尾模式。我们的发现表明，长程皮层-皮层耦合的成熟支持皮层功能层级模式从最初由几何约束主导的组织中逐渐涌现。

papers.title: Reward expectation signals in the superior colliculus during associative learning
papers.translated_title: 关联学习过程中上丘的奖赏预期信号
papers.author: Mutlu, S.
papers.summary: Predicting future rewards allows neutral sensory cues to acquire motivational significance and guide goal-directed actions that maximise reward acquisition. These reward predictions are updated when outcomes differ from expectations resulting in an error in prediction. Midbrain dopamine neurons provide a canonical neural correlate of reward prediction error signal that are broadcast to multiple brain areas. These learned reward predictions ultimately influence neural processes that enable animals to select, prepare and execute actions towards expected rewards. Reward expectation signals have been observed across sensory and motor circuits where they can modulate sensory processing and action selection and vigor. This raises the question of how integrative sensorimotor circuits represent information about reward expectation alongside sensory and motor variables that drive reward-seeking actions. The superior colliculus (SC), a sensorimotor area in the midbrain traditionally associated with orienting and action selection, is strongly influenced by reward context. Expected reward modulates visual and premotor activity, learned object values shape sensory responses, and recent reward alters visual processing in the mouse SC. The SC also provides input to midbrain dopamine neurons and can relay or acquire conditioned sensory responses that influence dopaminergic activity. However, SC projections can also drive orienting movements without supporting reinforcement, raising the possibility that cue-related activity reflects salience or motor preparation rather than reward prediction itself. Here, using an associative-learning task in which auditory cues predicted distinct reward probabilities, together with longitudinal monitoring of intermediate SC population activity across learning, we asked whether the SC acquires signals related to reward probability, whether these signals can be dissociated from anticipatory licking, and whether outcome responses exhibit the hallmarks of reward-prediction errors. We found that cue-evoked SC activity progressively differentiated reward probabilities across learning, and that cue-associated reward probability explained neural activity beyond anticipatory licking. Thus, the intermediate SC carries a learned reward-expectation signal that is multiplexed with, but not reducible to, motor preparation. By contrast, outcome responses did not exhibit a consistent population-level signature of reward-prediction errors. Together, these findings identify the SC as a site where predicted reward is integrated with anticipatory action during associative learning.
papers.translated_summary: 预测未来奖励使中性感觉线索能够获得动机意义，并引导旨在最大化奖励获取的目标导向行为。当结果与预期不同时，这些奖励预测会被更新，从而产生预测误差。中脑多巴胺神经元提供了奖励预测误差信号的经典神经相关物，该信号被广播到多个脑区。这些习得的奖励预测最终影响神经过程，使动物能够选择、准备并执行朝向预期奖励的动作。奖励预期信号已在感觉和运动回路中被观察到，它们可以在其中调节感觉处理以及动作选择和活力。这引出了一个问题：整合性感觉运动回路如何在与驱动奖励寻求动作的感觉和运动变量并存的情况下，表征关于奖励预期的信息。上丘（SC）是中脑的一个感觉运动区域，传统上与定向和动作选择相关，并受到奖励情境的强烈影响。预期奖励调节视觉和前运动活动，习得的客体价值塑造感觉反应，而近期奖励改变小鼠SC中的视觉处理。SC还向中脑多巴胺神经元提供输入，并且能够传递或获得影响多巴胺能活动的条件性感觉反应。然而，SC投射也可以驱动定向运动而不支持强化，这提高了这样一种可能性：线索相关活动反映的是显著性或多动准备，而不是奖励预测本身。在这里，我们使用一项联想学习任务，其中听觉线索预测不同的奖励概率，并结合对整个学习过程中中间SC群体活动的纵向监测，来探究SC是否获得与奖励概率相关的信号，这些信号是否可以与预期性舔舐分离，以及结果反应是否表现出奖励预测误差的标志性特征。我们发现，线索诱发的SC活动在学习过程中逐渐区分奖励概率，并且线索相关的奖励概率在预期性舔舐之外解释了神经活动。因此，中间SC携带一种习得的奖励预期信号，该信号与运动准备多重并存，但不能还原为运动准备。相比之下，结果反应并未表现出一致的群体水平奖励预测误差特征。总之，这些发现将SC确定为在联想学习过程中预测奖励与预期性动作被整合的位点。

papers.title: ESCRT-I Inhibition Protects against NMDAR Hypofunction and Restores Synaptic Homeostasis in a Cellular Model of Schizophrenia
papers.translated_title: ESCRT-I抑制可保护精神分裂症细胞模型中的NMDAR功能低下并恢复突触稳态
papers.author: Shalaby, M.
papers.summary: N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) hypofunction is a central pathophysiological mechanism in schizophrenia, yet direct NMDAR potentiation has shown limited clinical benefit, potentially because it fails to address deficits in receptor trafficking and surface stability. The endosomal sorting complexes required for transport (ESCRT) machinery governs the lysosomal fate of internalised membrane proteins, but its role in synaptic receptor homeostasis during glutamatergic dysfunction remains unclear. Phencyclidine (PCP), a non-competitive NMDAR antagonist, is widely used to model NMDAR hypofunction and schizophrenia-like phenotypes. Here, we show that sub-chronic PCP exposure induced persistent NMDAR hypofunction, impaired GABAergic transmission, and collapsed of excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance in primary hippocampal neurons. Genetic inhibition of the ESCRT-I component TSG101 prevented these deficits, enabled functional recovery following PCP washout, and increased surface expression of functional NMDARs and GABAA receptors without altering receptor pharmacology or biophysical properties. At the network level, TSG101 knockdown restored inhibitory tone, normalised excitatory activity, and stabilised E/I balance. Moreover, TSG101 knockdown rescued PCP-induced reductions in PSD-95 and BDNF, restored ERK1/2 signalling, and re-established activity-dependent nuclear translocation of Fos-like (Fos-L), consistent with reactivation of transcriptional plasticity. These findings identify ESCRT-I as a regulator of synaptic stability, positioning endosomal sorting pathways as a potential therapeutic target for schizophrenia.
papers.translated_summary: N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体（NMDAR）功能低下是精神分裂症的核心病理生理机制，然而直接增强NMDAR的临床获益有限，这可能是因为它未能解决受体转运和表面稳定性方面的缺陷。转运所需内体分选复合体（ESCRT）机制调控内化膜蛋白的溶酶体命运，但其在谷氨酸能功能障碍期间突触受体稳态中的作用仍不清楚。苯环己哌啶（PCP）是一种非竞争性NMDAR拮抗剂，被广泛用于模拟NMDAR功能低下和精神分裂症样表型。在此，我们表明亚慢性PCP暴露在原代海马神经元中诱导了持续性NMDAR功能低下、GABA能传递受损以及兴奋/抑制（E/I）平衡崩溃。对ESCRT-I组分TSG101的遗传抑制阻止了这些缺陷，使PCP洗脱后功能恢复成为可能，并增加了功能性NMDAR和GABAA受体的表面表达，而不改变受体药理学或生物物理特性。在网络层面，TSG101敲低恢复了抑制性张力，使兴奋性活动正常化，并稳定了E/I平衡。此外，TSG101敲低挽救了PCP诱导的PSD-95和BDNF减少，恢复了ERK1/2信号传导，并重建了Fos样（Fos-L）的活动依赖性核转位，这与转录可塑性的重新激活一致。这些发现将ESCRT-I确定为突触稳定性的调节因子，将内体分选通路定位为精神分裂症的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Ancestree: unified likelihood inference of ancestral alleles under supplied or inferred genealogies
papers.translated_title: Ancestree：在给定或推断的谱系下对祖先等位基因进行统一似然推断
papers.author: Sendrowski, J.
papers.summary: Inferring ancestral states--determining, at each polymorphic site, which allele is ancestral and which derived--underpins many downstream population-genetic analyses, from selection scans and the unfolded site-frequency spectrum to demographic inference. However, no existing tool uniformly supports the full range of relevant inputs: plain variant data or ancestral recombination graphs (ARGs), with or without outgroups, while accommodating poly-allelic and recurrently-mutated sites. Here we present Ancestree, a likelihood-based engine that unifies these inputs within a single framework and returns full posteriors over the four nucleotide states at every site. It runs in three modes: a fixed-tree mode that assumes a single topology across sites and co-infers the per-branch substitution rates by maximum likelihood; an ARG mode that reads a different local tree at each site directly from a supplied ancestral recombination graph; and a local-tree mode that instead samples those local trees from the genotype data via a pairwise-coalescent HMM, needing no pre-existing ARG. On simulated data, the genealogy-based modes (ARG and local-tree) are more accurate and scale better, and remain robust under outgroup configurations that violate the fixed-tree assumption. Outgroups themselves remain difficult to replace: per-site inference accuracy on ingroup-polymorphic sites is markedly limited without them, and improves substantially with a single outgroup. The hardest sites are those fixed for the derived allele within the ingroup, which carry no within-ingroup signal and so need several sufficiently deep outgroups to recover, yet these are also highly informative downstream, carrying the high-frequency divergence signal on which selection and adaptation analyses often depend. Ancestree is available at github.com/Sendrowski/Ancestree.
papers.translated_summary: 推断祖先状态——即在每个多态位点上确定哪个等位基因是祖先型、哪个是衍生型——是许多下游群体遗传学分析的基础，从选择扫描和未折叠位点频率谱到人口统计学推断。然而，现有工具无法统一支持所有相关输入类型：普通变异数据或祖先重组图（ARGs），无论有无外群，同时还要处理多等位基因和反复突变位点。在此我们提出 Ancestree，一个基于似然的引擎，在单一框架内统一这些输入，并返回每个位点四种核苷酸状态的完整后验分布。它以三种模式运行：固定树模式，假设所有位点共享单一拓扑结构，并通过最大似然联合推断各分支的替换率；ARG 模式，直接从提供的祖先重组图中读取每个位点不同的局部树；以及局部树模式，通过成对溯祖 HMM 从基因型数据中采样这些局部树，无需预先存在的 ARG。在模拟数据上，基于谱系的模式（ARG 和局部树）更准确且扩展性更好，并且在违反固定树假设的外群配置下仍保持稳健。外群本身仍然难以替代：在没有外群的情况下，内群多态位点的单位点推断准确性显著受限，而加入单个外群后准确性大幅提升。最困难的位点是那些在内群中固定为衍生等位基因的位点，它们不携带内群内信号，因此需要多个足够深的外群才能恢复，但这些位点在下游分析中信息量极高，携带着选择和适应分析常常依赖的高频分歧信号。Ancestree 可在 github.com/Sendrowski/Ancestree 获取。

papers.title: Towards reconstruction of the human interactome from positive and negative experimental evidence
papers.translated_title: 从正反实验证据重建人类相互作用组
papers.author: As, J.
papers.summary: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) have been detected and reported in the millions, but while they are used in many different contexts for better understanding cellular processes in health and disease, the knowledge of the human PPI network is far from complete, containing many false positive measurements and being highly biased. Both to chart the extent of those problems and to solve them requires not just a knowledge of high-confidence positive interactions, but also likely non-interacting protein pairs. However, this information is typically not reported in PPI studies. We developed a methodology to reconstruct this knowledge from existing PPI data. We reconstruct the experimental search space in which PPI screens have been performed and then create a model that informs how likely a PPI is real given its testing and observation frequency. We argue that negative protein pairs allow us to estimate the error rates of experimental and computational screens. We show how this knowledge could be incorporated for calibration. Finally, we evaluate a simple machine learning approach to PPI prediction and propose how such negative data can be used for training instead of random protein pairs. Together, our results show that reconstructing the experimental search space recovers a largely overlooked layer of information from existing PPI data that can help guide a more accurate and complete mapping of the human interactome.
papers.translated_summary: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用已被检测和报道了数百万次，尽管它们被用于许多不同的情境中以更好地理解健康和疾病中的细胞过程，但关于人类蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络的知识远未完整，其中包含许多假阳性测量结果且高度偏倚。无论是为了描绘这些问题的范围还是解决它们，不仅需要了解高置信度的阳性相互作用，还需要了解可能不相互作用的蛋白质对。然而，这类信息在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用研究中通常未被报道。我们开发了一种方法，从现有的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用数据中重建这些知识。我们重建了已执行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用筛选的实验搜索空间，然后创建了一个模型，用以说明给定某个蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的测试频率和观测频率时，它为真的可能性有多大。我们认为，阴性蛋白质对使我们能够估计实验和计算筛选的错误率。我们展示了如何将这些知识纳入校准。最后，我们评估了一种用于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用预测的简单机器学习方法，并提出如何利用这类阴性数据而非随机蛋白质对进行训练。总之，我们的结果表明，重建实验搜索空间从现有蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用数据中恢复了一个在很大程度上被忽视的信息层，这有助于指导更准确、更完整地绘制人类相互作用组图谱。

papers.title: Delta rhythm and voice familiarity organize neural entrainment in the infant brain
papers.translated_title: Delta节律与声音熟悉度组织婴儿大脑中的神经夹带
papers.author: Rambosson, I.
papers.summary: The delta frequency band (~0.5-3.5 Hz) represents a phylogenetically conserved tempo of biological communication, and neural entrainment to this timescale would be a key mechanism through which the brain might generate temporal predictions. While entrainment at different levels has been characterized in adults, the mechanisms of auditory temporal prediction remain poorly studied across developmental trajectories, particularly regarding the roles of stimulus rhythmicity, frequency specificity, and voice familiarity. Using high-density EEG, we examined neural entrainment in thirty 6-month-old infants exposed to vocally rhythmic syllables produced by their mother or a stranger at delta (2 Hz) or theta (4 Hz) rates, as well as a non-rhythmic control. Auditory temporal regularity elicited a broad frontotemporal entrainment response. Critically, delta-band entrainment was frequency-specific across frontal and temporal clusters, with right-frontal selectivity progressively strengthening throughout the entrainment period as expected if this region actively refines a temporal model of the input rather than passively resonating to it; no significant theta-band specificity was observed. Entrainment was further shaped by voice familiarity: the left temporal cortex entrained selectively to the mother's voice, whereas the right frontal cluster responded selectively to the stranger's voice. This is consistent with an implementation in which familiarity-based processing within mid-temporal language-related regions interfaces with novelty-sensitive frontal mechanisms, and reflects the ongoing updating of internal predictive models rather than passive sensory registration. The co-occurrence of frequency-specific delta entrainment and experience-dependent hemispheric asymmetries reveals a neural functional network for hierarchical temporal predictions, shaped by early auditory experience and already in place at 6 months.
papers.translated_summary: delta频段（约0.5-3.5 Hz）代表了一种在系统发育上保守的生物交流节律，而神经对该时间尺度的夹带将是大脑产生时间预测的关键机制。尽管不同层次的夹带已在成人中得到表征，但听觉时间预测的机制在发育轨迹中仍研究不足，尤其是刺激节律性、频率特异性和声音熟悉度的作用。我们使用高密度脑电图，考察了30名6个月大婴儿在暴露于由其母亲或陌生人产生的delta（2 Hz）或theta（4 Hz）节律性语音音节以及非节律性对照时的神经夹带。听觉时间规律性引发了广泛的额颞夹带反应。关键的是，delta频段夹带在额叶和颞叶集群中具有频率特异性，右额叶选择性在整个夹带期间逐渐增强，这符合该区域主动细化输入的时间模型而非被动对其共振的预期；未观察到显著的theta频段特异性。夹带还进一步受到声音熟悉度的塑造：左侧颞叶皮层选择性地对母亲的声音产生夹带，而右侧额叶集群则选择性地对陌生人的声音作出反应。这与一种实现方式一致，即颞中叶语言相关区域内基于熟悉度的加工与对新异性敏感的额叶机制相互作用，并反映了内部预测模型的持续更新而非被动的感觉登记。频率特异性delta夹带与经验依赖的半球不对称性的共同出现，揭示了一个用于层级时间预测的神经功能网络，该网络由早期听觉经验塑造，并已在6个月时形成。

papers.title: Cortical high frequency oscillations reflect encoding and retrieval of specific word concepts
papers.translated_title: 皮层高频振荡反映了特定词语概念的编码和提取
papers.author: Cimbalnik, J.
papers.summary: High gamma and ripple frequency oscillations are engaged in encoding and recall of memory traces. Tracking specific traces with their signature neural activities across time and various tasks remains a major challenge. Using intracranial electrode recordings from epilepsy patients, we detected bursts of high-frequency oscillations in response to viewing and remembering the same common nouns in two different tasks repeated on subsequent days. We found the lowest word response selectivity of approximately 40% in the visual sensory areas and increasingly higher selectivity in the more anterior associational regions. The same word sets identified as preferred in a screening task triggered selective responses in another task during visual presentation or free recall with no sensory stimulation in the same session, and on the following day. We demonstrate that persistent reactivation of large-scale neuronal assemblies underlying particular concepts is reflected in bursts of high-frequency oscillations in the human cortex.
papers.translated_summary: 高频伽马和涟漪频率振荡参与记忆痕迹的编码与提取。跨时间及多种任务追踪特定痕迹及其特征性神经活动仍是一项重大挑战。利用癫痫患者的颅内电极记录，我们在连续几天重复的两个不同任务中，检测到对观看和记忆相同普通名词产生的高频振荡爆发。我们发现，视觉感觉区域的最低词汇反应选择性约为40%，而在更前部的联合区域选择性逐渐增高。在筛选任务中被确定为偏好的相同词汇集，在同一会话中无感觉刺激的视觉呈现或自由回忆期间，以及次日，均引发了另一任务中的选择性反应。我们证明，特定概念所依赖的大规模神经元集群的持续再激活，反映为人类皮层中高频振荡的爆发。

papers.title: An updated roadmap for brain-mental health associations in the UK Biobank
papers.translated_title: 英国生物银行中大脑与心理健康关联的最新路线图
papers.author: Li, X.
papers.summary: The UK Biobank offers an unprecedented opportunity to examine associations between brain imaging and mental health at scale, but their magnitude and replicability remain unclear. We correlated 17,580 imaging-derived phenotypes across seven MRI modalities with 309 mental health phenotypes in 8,415 participants, split into discovery and validation subsets. Associations were generally small (median |r| = 0.018; top 1% of 0.108), and they replicated poorly: only 9.0% of significant discovery associations were significant in validation. Eating disorders showed the largest effects of any mental disorders but replicated in only 6.0% of cases, whereas substance use showed the highest replication (14.5%). Susceptibility-weighted imaging produced the most replicable imaging associations. Longitudinal changes in brain and mental health measures were weakly related. We provide an interactive dashboard that returns the effect-size and replicability benchmarks for any combination of mental health category and imaging modality, supporting variable selection and study design in UK Biobank research.
papers.translated_summary: 英国生物银行提供了在大规模上研究脑影像与心理健康之间关联的前所未有的机会，但其效应量和可重复性仍不清楚。我们在8，415名参与者中，将七种MRI模态的17，580个影像衍生表型与309个心理健康表型进行相关分析，并分为发现子集和验证子集。关联通常较小（中位|r| = 0.018；前1%为0.108），且可重复性较差：在发现集中显著的关联中，仅9.0%在验证集中显著。进食障碍在所有精神障碍中显示出最大的效应，但仅在6.0%的案例中可重复，而物质使用显示出最高的可重复性（14.5%）。磁敏感加权成像产生的影像关联最可重复。脑与心理健康指标的纵向变化之间关系微弱。我们提供了一个交互式仪表板，可返回任何心理健康类别与影像模态组合的效应量和可重复性基准，支持英国生物银行研究中的变量选择和研究设计。

papers.title: Active Bed Microclimate Regulation Modulates Sleep Architecture, Autonomic, and Central Nervous System Activity during Sleep
papers.translated_title: 主动床微气候调节可调控睡眠期间的睡眠结构、自主神经系统和中枢神经系统活动
papers.author: Garcia Molina, G. N.
papers.summary: Skin temperature and bed microclimate are established modulators of human sleep, but most prior work has relied on passive thermal materials. We used a smart bed capable of heating or cooling the microclimate to investigate how six temperature settings affect sleep architecture, autonomic activity, and electroencephalographic (EEG) activity. Eighteen adults (9 male, 9 female; mean age 44.5 years) completed two overnight polysomnography sessions with bed temperature assigned via Latin-square counterbalancing across three-hour segments of high cooling, medium cooling, low cooling, off, low heating, and medium heating. Mixed-effects regression models evaluated manipulation checks on induced thermal changes, the probability of sleep versus wake, and the probability of each sleep stage (N1, N2, N3, REM), while secondary analyses assessed sleep deepening, heart rate, and EEG spectral power. Temperature manipulations significantly affected sleep and physiological outcomes. All five active settings shifted sleep toward greater depth, increasing the odds of slow-wave sleep (odds ratios 1.21 to 3.65, largest for high cooling) and reducing the odds of light non-rapid eye movement sleep relative to off. Heating accelerated early sleep deepening relative to cooling without significantly altering sleep onset latency, whereas cooling produced a graded reduction in heart rate. EEG analyses revealed distinct cortical signatures for heating and cooling conditions. These findings demonstrate that active bed microclimate regulation modulates sleep architecture, autonomic activity, and cortical activity during sleep. The nonlinear pattern of effects suggests thermal "sweet spots" that may vary across the night and individuals, supporting the development of individualized programmable temperature-regulation strategies for sleep optimization.
papers.translated_summary: 皮肤温度和床微气候是已确立的人类睡眠调节因素，但此前大多数研究依赖于被动热材料。我们使用一种能够加热或冷却微气候的智能床，研究六种温度设置如何影响睡眠结构、自主神经活动和脑电图活动。18名成年人（9名男性，9名女性；平均年龄44.5岁）完成了两次整夜多导睡眠监测，床温通过拉丁方平衡分配，覆盖三个小时的高冷却、中冷却、低冷却、关闭、低加热和中加热时段。混合效应回归模型评估了对诱导热变化的操纵检验、睡眠与觉醒的概率，以及各睡眠阶段（N1、N2、N3、REM）的概率，二次分析评估了睡眠加深、心率和脑电频谱功率。温度操纵显著影响了睡眠和生理结果。与关闭相比，所有五种主动设置均使睡眠向更深程度转变，增加了慢波睡眠的比值比（比值比1.21至3.65，高冷却最大），并降低了浅非快速眼动睡眠的比值比。与冷却相比，加热加速了早期睡眠加深，但未显著改变入睡潜伏期，而冷却则产生了心率的分级降低。脑电分析揭示了加热和冷却条件下不同的皮层特征。这些发现表明，主动床微气候调节可调控睡眠期间的睡眠结构、自主神经活动和皮层活动。效应的非线性模式提示存在热“最佳点”，其可能随夜间时段和个体而变化，支持开发用于睡眠优化的个体化可编程温度调节策略。
